title: primula elatior subsp. pseudoelatior
intro: Primula elatior subsp. pseudoelatior, commonly known as Pseudo Elatior or False Greater Primrose, is a plant species within the Primulaceae family. This plant is said to have health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various health conditions such as digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Primula elatior subsp. pseudoelatior include its ability to act as a demulcent and expectorant, helping to soothe and calm irritated tissues and promote the clearance of mucus. Bioactive constituents found in this plant include iridoid glycosides and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
